description:
Rebuild of dilapidated coach house behind its retained façade, with new building on the same footprint, to be linked to the main dwelling. Construction of rear garden building on footprint of demolished garden building. Works to the front façade including reinstatement of historic door and lintel, replacement brickwork, increased height of front wall, and replacement of coach house window and door. Replacement of third floor dormer window with sash window and replacement of lower ground and first floor windows to rear elevation. Replacement lower ground floor door and step cladding. 

Incorporation of ancillary basement level flat to the family dwelling by internal alterations, including reinstatement of the main staircase. Additional internal alterations including the removal of two kitchens, restoration of entrance hall, reconfiguration of first floor walls, removal of second floor wall and door to stair, installation of bathroom, reinstatement of ceiling line in attic rooms, removal of modern joinery, and replacement and reinstatement of fire places.

[Planning Application ref. P2025/3640/FUL also submitted]
